about: Hand-maintained notes explaining known data problems, each with its official source. Checked against the police.uk 'Known issues' page on 26 October 2026. Notes explain gaps; they never add or estimate counts.

greater-manchester.note: The police.uk site states that no crime, outcome or stop-and-search data is currently available for Greater Manchester Police while it moves to a new IT system. Its street-level series is missing for most months. The Home Office totals are shown instead.

btp.note: No British Transport Police crime data has been published on police.uk for every month since March 2025, and anti-social behaviour data has been missing since April 2016. Rail points that fall inside Scotland are left out of the cells.

gloucestershire.note: Gloucestershire Constabulary had not provided crime data for February to August 2026 at the last check; the force says it will provide a refresh. No reason is given.

avon-and-somerset.note: Since a change of IT systems in 2015 the force publishes around 2,000 crimes a month without a latitude and longitude. Those records are counted in force totals but cannot appear in any cell, so cell counts for this force are lower than the true figure.
